description: Search TradeIndia products or suppliers by keyword, or fetch products and supplier profiles by URL/ID. All data is public and cookieless.

businessTypes.description: Keep only listings whose supplier matches at least one selected type. Leave empty for all types. Applied after fetching because TradeIndia ignores these flags on keyword search.
businessTypes.sectionDescription: Optional filters for the two search modes.
businessTypes.title: Business type filter

buyerFeedbackOnly.description: Keep listings whose supplier has a buyer-feedback rating.
buyerFeedbackOnly.title: Only suppliers with buyer feedback

cities.description: Optional Indian city names (e.g. Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai). Leave empty for all of India. The city filter is applied by TradeIndia itself.
cities.title: Filter by city

includeContact.description: Details modes and enriched searches: add the publicly listed phone/email of the supplier when TradeIndia publishes it.
includeContact.title: Include published phone and email

includeDetails.description: Search modes: fetch each product/supplier page for full specifications and company details. Slower and more requests; off by default.
includeDetails.title: Enrich search results with detail pages

maxItems.description: Maximum number of product or supplier records to emit.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Stop conditions; the actor also stops when TradeIndia runs out of results.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxProductsPerSupplier.description: supplierDetails: how many of the supplier's products to list on the company record.
maxProductsPerSupplier.title: Max products per supplier (details)

mode.description: Search listings by keyword, or look up product/supplier pages by URL or numeric ID.
enumTitles: Product details by URL or ID
Supplier details by URL or ID
mode.sectionDescription: Search modes read keyword result pages; details modes read the product or company page you paste below.
mode.title: What to collect

searchQueries.description: One or more product or supplier keywords, e.g. "rubber gaskets", "cotton fabric", "LED lights" (search modes).
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Used by the two search modes. Every query is combined with every city.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

shopOnline.description: Keep products ready for immediate online purchase (Ti Shopping).
shopOnline.title: Only online-purchasable products

startUrls.description: TradeIndia product URLs (…/products/…-c123456.html), company profile URLs (…/company-name-357545/), or bare numeric IDs. Used by the two details modes.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Paste links or IDs for productDetails / supplierDetails.
startUrls.title: Product or supplier URLs / IDs

trustStamp.description: Keep products or companies holding TradeIndia's trust stamp.
trustStamp.title: Only Ti Trusted suppliers

withPrice.description: Drop listings that do not publish a price.
withPrice.title: Only listings with a price

title: TradeIndia B2B Product & Supplier Scraper Input
